title: Define the arbitrary multi-valued exercise type model
acceptance_criteria: The domain type contract accepts arbitrary non-empty exercise type values rather than a Strength/Stretch-only union.
The canonical exercise representation supports an ordered list of distinct type values for records with multiple source types.
Routine group and draft types have an explicit, type-safe relationship to the multi-valued exercise representation.
No evidence or source metadata is added to the user-facing Exercise, ExerciseDraft, or storage state model.
